name: 7DaysToDie
description: This Docker will download and install SteamCMD. It will also install 7 Days to Die and run it. ATTENTION: First Startup can take very long since it downloads the gameserver files! Update Notice: Simply restart the container if a newer version of the game is available. You can also run multiple servers with only one SteamCMD directory!

ports.name: UDP5 - Registering at server list
ports.description: Should be in the range 27015 - 27030, don't forget to set also a different Container Port if you change this value.

variables.name: GAME_ID
variables.description: The GAME_ID that the container download at startup. (https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/Dedicated_Servers_List) If you want to use a static version of the game and not always the latest one then enter this: '294420 -beta stable_alpha19.4' or '294420 -beta latest_experimental' (without quotes) if you want to stay for example on alpha19.4.

variables.name: Serverconfig
variables.description: Please change if your serverconfigfile has another name.

variables.name: GAME_PARAMS
variables.description: Enter your start up commands for the server.

variables.name: Steam-Username
variables.description: Your Steam username goes here if you want to install a game that needs a valid account, otherwise leave it blank (ATTENTION: You have to disable Steam Guard).

variables.name: Validate Installation
variables.description: Set the Variable to 'true' if you want to validate the installation otherwise leave it blank.

variables.name: Steam-Password
variables.description: Your Steam password goes here if you want to install a game that needs a valid account, otherwise leave it blank (ATTENTION: You have to disable Steam Guard).

variables.name: BepInEx
variables.description: If you want to enable BepInEx set this variable to 'true' (without quotes).
